home.heroTitle: Find the perfect date for your next session
home.heroSubtitle: Create a monthly room, share it with your party, and discover days with 100% quorum in real-time.
home.campaignHelp: A clear name so your party easily recognizes the session.
home.participantsHelp: Add all table members (including the Dungeon Master). Minimum 2 participants.
home.emptyParticipants: No adventurers added yet. Type a name and click Add.
home.errorMinParticipants: You must add at least 2 participants to coordinate.
home.shareModalSubtitle: Share this link with your players so they can mark their availability.
home.tip1Desc: Send the direct link via WhatsApp or Discord to your gaming group.
home.tip2Desc: Upon joining, players pick their character and click the days they are available.
home.tip3Desc: Days when everyone is free are automatically highlighted in emerald green with a star.

misMesas.importError: No table found with that link or code.
misMesas.emptySubtitle: Create a new room or link an existing one using its link.
misMesas.deleteTitle: Remove this table from your list?
misMesas.deleteDesc: It will only be removed from this device. The room will remain active for other players.

claimModal.title: Who are you in this campaign?
claimModal.subtitle: Select your character to mark your free days. You can also join as a spectator.

footer.tagline: CoordinatorDnD • Built for tabletop RPG groups tired of scheduling sessions over WhatsApp.

tutorial.helpSubtitle: Learn how to schedule your tabletop RPG sessions in minutes
tutorial.resetSuccess: Tutorial restarted! Tips will appear as you navigate.

home_create.title: Create your first game table!
home_create.desc: Pick the target month and enter the adventurers' names. Clicking 'Create Monthly Poll' generates a unique shareable link.

room_claim.title: Choose your character
room_claim.desc: Click here to pick your adventurer or join as a spectator. This lets you mark your available days.

room_vote.title: Mark your free days!
room_vote.desc: Click on any day in the calendar to indicate you can play. Your votes sync instantly in real time.

room_views.title: Views and quick filters
room_views.desc: Switch between 'Month' grid and mobile 'Agenda' view. Use quick filters to focus on weekends or upcoming dates.

room_export.title: Export when quorum is reached
room_export.desc: When everyone is free on the same day (100% quorum), copy a markdown party summary for WhatsApp or add the session directly to Google Calendar or .ics.

tables_hub.title: Your saved tables
tables_hub.desc: Rooms you create or visit are automatically remembered on your device so you never lose track of active campaigns.

guideItems.item1Desc: No login required. Share the room link with your gaming party over WhatsApp
guideItems.item2Desc: Each adventurer claims their name so the party sees who is available on each date.
guideItems.item3Desc: Tap your free days. Changes update in real time for everyone in the room.
guideItems.item4Desc: The app highlights dates where everyone can make it and generates direct calendar links.
